blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. joined the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) on Wednesday, October 14, to launch programs for disadvantaged workers seeking employment, skills certification, and livelihood opportunities. The event in Lapu-Lapu City featured three flagship innovations under DOLE’s Tulong Panghanapbuhay sa Ating Disadvantaged Workers (TUPAD) program: Trabahong-Dagat, SkillPass, and Sagip-Trabaho. READ: Marcos’ trust rating rises to 36%, but Duterte remains ahead at 56% Programs target workers, businesses Trabahong-Dagat links coastal communities to fisheries-related training, jobs, and livelihood opportunities, while SkillPass documents TUPAD beneficiaries’ work experience and competencies for certification or employment.
